name: Ouroboros: Generating Longer Drafts Phrase by Phrase for Faster Speculative Decoding
notes: Ouroboros generates draft phrases to parallelize drafting and lengthen drafts in a training-free manner. Speedups up to 2.8x over speculative decoding and 3.9x over vanilla decoding. No fine-tuning of draft or target models. Published at EMNLP 2024.
